title_en: Hot Toys' Incredibly Lifelike Avengers: Doomsday Figures Give Us a Much Better Look at X-Men Like Ian McKellen's Magneto and Channing Tatum's Gambit
summary_en: Hot Toys' Avengers: Doomsday figures have been revealed, giving us a much better look at key X-Men characters like Ian McKellen's Magneto and Channing Tatum's Gambit.
body_en:
Marvel's Comic-Con panel seems to have opened the floodgates in terms of Avengers: Doomsday merchandise, as multiple companies have now revealed the action figures and collectibles they'll be releasing alongside the film this December. That includes Hot Toys. And, true to form, these incredibly detailed figures are giving us our best look yet at key Doomsday characters like Ian McKellen's Magneto and Channing Tatum's Gambit.
Check out the slideshow gallery below to see the first wave of Hot Toys' Avengers: Doomsday figures:
Hot Toys' initial lineup of figures includes James Marsden's Cyclops, Robert Downey, Jr.'s Doctor Doom, Channing Tatum's Gambit, and Ian McKellen's Magneto. Doom will also be getting a separate throne accessory. It's worth noting that Sideshow Collectibles' Comic-Con booth also has figures of Patrick Stewart's Professor Xavier, Kelsey Grammer's Beast, and a Sentinel on display, but those figures haven't gone live for preorder yet.
This is definitely our best look yet at McKellen in his latest (and presumably final) appearance as the Master of Magnetism. Fittingly, McKellen's costume looks to be his most heavily comic-inspired one yet, complete with the red and purple helmet and red suit.
As for Tatum's Gambit, things haven't changed too much from his previous appearance in 2024's Deadpool & Wolverine, though this costume appears to be a bit darker and more muted to suit the grittier tone of Doomsday.
All of these 1:6 scale figures will be released in both standard and Deluxe Edition versions, with the latter including more accessories and more elaborate display bases. The Deluxe Cyclops even comes with a removable leather jacket for that peak '90s X-Men look.
These figures will all be released between October 2026 and December 2027. The non-deluxe Doom figure is an "Early Access" release guaranteed to come out in time for the movie. You can find preorder links for everything below:
